mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ are called electrons and positive charges are called protons.
Negative charges are called electrons and positive charges are called protons.
Fill in the blank: ______ is called the momentum and r is the distance of the electron from the nucleus (or radius of the allowed orbit).
The quantity mv is called the momentum and r is the distance of the electron from the nucleus (or radius of the allowed orbit).
Fill in the blank: ______ is made up of protons and neutrons.
The nucleus is made up of protons and neutrons.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a way the scientist gives its own picture of how an atom looks like.
An atomic model is a way the scientist gives its own picture of how an atom looks like.
fib: ______ is used to describe their magnetic properties.
The spin is used to describe their magnetic properties.
______ is a jump from one energy level to another.
A transition is a jump from one energy level to another.
